```sql
alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

create or replace function public.class_has_capacity(p_class_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
    and (select count(*)::integer from public.class_spots s where s.class_id = c.id and s.status = 'enrolled') < c.capacity
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_class_instructor(p_class_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
    and c.instructor_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$$;

create policy "classes_select_authenticated"
on public.classes for select to authenticated
using (true);

create policy "class_spots_select_own_or_instructor"
on public.class_spots for select to authenticated
using (user_id = (select auth.uid()) or public.is_class_instructor(class_id));

create policy "class_spots_insert_own_enrolled_or_waitlisted"
on public.class_spots for insert to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = (select auth.uid())
  and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
  and (
    status = 'enrolled'
    and public.class_has_capacity(class_id)
    or status = 'waitlisted'
    and not public.class_has_capacity(class_id)
  )
);

create policy "class_spots_update_own_waitlisted_to_enrolled"
on public.class_spots for update to authenticated
using (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'waitlisted' and public.class_has_capacity(class_id))
with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'enrolled');

create policy "class_spots_delete_own"
on public.class_spots for delete to authenticated
using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

create policy "class_spots_delete_instructor"
on public.class_spots for delete to authenticated
using (public.is_class_instructor(class_id));
```
